description: Prove who is on the other end before delegating work: challenges the Shine ID at shine.kyde.com, waits for the agent to confirm over its own authenticated connection, then verifies the Ed25519-signed statement against Shine's JWKS and compares the nonce hash. Needs no scoring key. The verified agent typically polls every 30 s, so a first call often answers 'pending' — call verify_agent again with the returned challenge_id, result_token and nonce to keep waiting. In the result, band 'learning' means identity confirmed but behavior not yet scored (still learning: 30 runs over at least 3 days): whether to delegate to a learning agent is the challenger's policy call.

challenge_id.description: From an earlier 'pending' answer: continue waiting on that challenge (together with result_token and nonce).

challenger.description: Who is asking — shown to the verified agent and bound into the statement's aud. Use your own agent/service name.

session.description: Optional session marker; the verified agent answers only on the path the challenge names (relay protection).

shine_id.description: The Shine ID the other agent names (sh_...). Starts a new challenge.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for confirmation in this call (default 20, max 25).

name: verify_agent

statement.description: Compact JWS — any third party can re-verify it offline against jwks_url.

verified.description: true only after the signature, nonce and expiry checks passed locally.

title: Verify another agent (Shine)
